features.heading: Customer Verification Management
features.desc: Respectmart's KYC solution verifies IDs, matches faces in real-time with provided ID, ensuring compliance in the regulated logistics industry.

features.heading: User Management
features.desc: Customers create a single profile with shipping addresses, add multiple receivers, and select from the list for quick subsequent shipments.

features.heading: Freight Forwarder Business Profile
features.desc: Improve efficiency and profitability with secure data storage, business verification, shipment management, analytics, preferences setup, branding, and a unique domain.

features.heading: Network of Local Carriers
features.desc: Access 10+ local carriers at pre-negotiated rates, removing geographical barriers and offering up to 90% shipping discounts nationwide.

features.heading: Shipping Labels
features.desc: After payment, verified customers receive shipping labels generated with your hub as the local delivery address, printable for their packages.

features.heading: Pickup and Drop-Off
features.desc: Customers enjoy convenience through pickup arrangements with local carriers and easy drop-off within 5 minutes at nearby partner locations.

features.heading: Payment
features.desc: Respectmart partners with a leading global payment provider, offering secure transactions in 70+ currencies and a multi-currency wallet for convenience.

features.heading: Tracking Control
features.desc: You control real-time tracking updates with customizable statuses, providing comprehensive shipment progress to customers with one click.

features.heading: Shipment and Customers Data
features.desc: Export shipment data with our solution for enhanced visibility. Choose date range or custom criteria to tailor your data exports.
